[FACT] User is interested in hiking trails near Bandung.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tangkuban Perahu Volcano is a popular hiking trail located 25 kilometers north of Bandung, taking about an hour and a half to reach the crater on foot.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Maribaya Waterfall trail is located 15 kilometers northeast of Bandung and takes around 45 minutes to hike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gunung Putri is a challenging hike located about 20 kilometers outside of Bandung, taking about 4-5 hours to complete and offering breathtaking views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cikapundung River trail follows the river for about 5 kilometers and is a popular spot for locals to relax and enjoy nature.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ciwidey Valley hike is about an hour's drive south of Bandung, taking 2-3 hours and leading through tea plantations and rice paddies to a beautiful waterfall.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tangkuban Perahu Volcano offers stunning panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and the city of Bandung.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gunung Putri provides an unobstructed 360-degree view of Bandung, including Tangkuban Perahu Volcano and lush rainforests.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ciwidey Valley hike offers stunning views of tea plantations and rice fields, along with a serene atmosphere.
